newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won finishes lower on dlr/yen gain.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won finishes lower on dlr/yen gain.

text.p: The won closed down versus the dollar in quiet Friday trading as the U.S. currency's rebound against the Japanese yen in Tokyo prompted dollar buying, traders said.
The won closed at 892.00 against Thursday's closing of 891.50. It traded in a range of 891.70 to 892.80.
Dealers said the won opened weak as the dollar/yen rose to 116 level in Tokyo from 114.70 overnight in the European market.
However, when the dollar/yen failed to rise to 117, the local unit rebounded from the intraday low and stabilised near 892.
They said as long as the central bank's dollar support at 890 continues, the won was expected to move in line with the movement of dollar/yen in the near term.
Dealers saw the base mid-rate at 892.20 for Monday against 891.20 for Friday.
